Critter Debug.name: Critter Debug
Critter Debug.description: Prints party and personal critter captures with (Unique) / (Non-Unique) status to chat.

Pest Debug.name: Pest Debug
Pest Debug.description: Log detailed garden pest, texture hash scanning and detection data.

Pest ESP Debug.name: Pest ESP Debug
Pest ESP Debug.description: Logs entity tags and raw pest detection info to chat.

Performance Debug.name: Performance Debug
Performance Debug.description: Log rendering execution times and frame drops.

Dungeon Map.name: Dungeon Map
Dungeon Map.description: Displays full live Catacombs dungeon map with rooms, doors & players.

Dungeon Map Scale.name: Dungeon Map Scale
Dungeon Map Scale.description: Scale multiplier for Dungeon Map HUD overlay.

Show Full Undiscovered Map.name: Show Full Undiscovered Map
Show Full Undiscovered Map.description: Renders unopened/undiscovered dungeon rooms preview in dimmed colors (Devonian & Doogan pre-discovery).

Player Trajectory Timeline.name: Player Trajectory Timeline
Player Trajectory Timeline.description: Enables interactive timeline slider under map to playback player positions over time.

Show Player Heads.name: Show Player Heads
Show Player Heads.description: Renders player head icons and directional markers on the map.

Show Room Secrets.name: Show Room Secrets
Show Room Secrets.description: Renders secret count on unexplored and cleared rooms.

Show Room Names.name: Show Room Names
Show Room Names.description: Renders puzzle names and abbreviations on map rooms.

Show Checkmarks.name: Show Checkmarks
Show Checkmarks.description: Renders white/green completion checkmarks on rooms.

Show Player Clears.name: Show Player Clears
Show Player Clears.description: Displays real-time room clear counts per party member.

Show Map in Boss.name: Show Map in Boss
Show Map in Boss.description: Keeps map visible during the boss fight.

Open Drag \u0026 Drop Organizer GUI.name: Open Drag & Drop Organizer GUI
Open Drag \u0026 Drop Organizer GUI.description: Opens dedicated drag & drop feature & category organizer (/b order).

Feature Category \u0026 Cheat Organizer.name: Feature Category & Cheat Organizer
Feature Category \u0026 Cheat Organizer.description: Customize feature categories, subcategories, tags, and cheat classifications via drag-and-drop (/b order).

Auto Accept Trevor Quest.name: Auto Accept Trevor Quest
Auto Accept Trevor Quest.description: Accepts Trevor trapper animal quests automatically.

Auto Kismet Reroll.name: Auto Kismet Reroll
Auto Kismet Reroll.description: Auto uses Kismet feather on chests.

Backdrop Dim.name: Backdrop Dim
Backdrop Dim.description: How dark the world gets behind the /b pv window. Lower is more transparent.

Slot Background Color.name: Slot Background Color
Slot Background Color.description: Interior fill color for item slots (HEX e.g. #1E293B).

Slot Background Opacity.name: Slot Background Opacity
Slot Background Opacity.description: Alpha transparency of item slot interior (0-255).

Slot Lining Color.name: Slot Lining Color
Slot Lining Color.description: Border and lining color around individual slots (HEX e.g. #FFFFFF).

Slot Lining Opacity.name: Slot Lining Opacity
Slot Lining Opacity.description: Alpha transparency of slot lining borders (0-255).

Hitman Interval (min).name: Hitman Interval (min)
Hitman Interval (min).description: Base interval in minutes (randomized around this target).
